run_gen_tutorials: run the script with --repo_dir to generate JS, HTML, ipynb, and py tutorial files
build_tutorial_html: build HTML tutorial files from Jupyter notebooks using nbconvert HTMLExporter and BeautifulSoup
build_tutorial_js: build React JS tutorial page files from a template for each tutorial ID
build_tutorial_py: build Python script files from Jupyter notebooks using nbconvert ScriptExporter
review_gen_tutorials: review the gen_tutorials function that reads tutorials.json and generates multiple output formats per notebook
